_note: RARE (blue) items, item level 50-60. Captured in a browser on the origin (a plain fetch is 403) as ONE two-pack payload, hashed there in four chunks and re-hashed joined on disk; that joined hash is _sha256_of_joined_payload and is the browser-verified provenance. _sha256_of_payload is computed at SPLIT time over this pack alone and is what the importer re-checks, so it guards the file on disk rather than the transfer.
